local_changes: Re-implemented the decision wire (jevkit/client.py ask/_check_answer) as a small stdlib module; upstream jevkit is ~48k LOC across 60+ modules (routing, mailbox, triage, browser/computer next-action) and none of that product surface is absorbed here.

Transport narrowed to the two doors that actually serve the bespoke contract: OpenCode Zen (/v1/systemone, key OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY) and TypeSafe (/v1/systemone, key TYPESAFE_API_KEY). opencode-go is NOT a candidate: it is an OpenAI-compatible chat relay with no decision model.
No images/box questions, no TypeSafe custom-endpoint override, no JEV_PROXY_API_KEY: those surfaces carry credential-forwarding risk and are not needed by an optional decision provider.
Credentials resolve only through agent.secret_scope.get_secret (never os.environ directly).
No keystore/credential-file reader: a missing key yields `unavailable`, never a silent fallback.
rebrand: Zero upstream product brand on Qubit surfaces; upstream identity appears only in this provenance record, NOTICE and file headers.
